fields.description: Delivery mechanism the owner selects for alert conditions. The options are the mechanisms engineering can qualify natively; the selected value is always the owner's.
fields.label: Channel kind

fields.description: Where alerts go under this version (for example an email address, a webhook URL or a desk slug). Owner-provided; engineering invents no destination.
fields.label: Receiver reference

fields.description: Minutes an alert condition may stay unacknowledged before it escalates. Leave empty for no escalation (owner choice).
fields.label: Escalate after minutes

fields.description: Days alert records are retained under this version. Required whenever a receiver is selected; the owner sets the value.
fields.label: Retention days

fields.description: Why this version was set. Mandatory on every version write.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: Closed date: the day this version stopped governing new activity. Written once when a newer version supersedes it; the row itself is never rewritten.
fields.label: Superseded on
